stem.text: What is the major product Z of the following reaction?

stem.alt: Reaction scheme: a ring compound with a methyl group, a ring C=C and an exocyclic C=CH2 reacts with an excess of dry HBr, warm, to give product Z.

A.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with two methyl groups and two Br atoms on different ring carbons (option A).

B.alt: Skeletal formula of 1,4-dibromo-1,4-dimethylcyclohexane: each Br and each methyl group sits on the same ring carbon (option B).

C.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with a methyl group and a Br on adjacent ring carbons, and a CH2Br group on a ring carbon further round (option C).

D.alt: Skeletal formula of a cyclohexane ring with a methyl group and a Br on the same ring carbon, and a CH2Br group on the opposite ring carbon (option D).
